'''April 2002 Livingston tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in New World Manga, Livingston, New Jersey on 27 April 2002. [[Bill Kafer]] won it. It is known from Kelly Krieble's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3615">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-29-livinston-nj-4-27-02-another-big-crowdd3615/ livinston-nj-4-27-02-another-big-crowd], DeckTech (Kelly "dr_divot" Krieble, 29 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-29-livinston-nj-4-27-02-another-big-crowdd3615/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 April 2002
* '''Site:''' New World Manga, Livingston, New Jersey
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Bill Kafer]]
